title: Frontend: Find largest number
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Find largest number. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values). Return the maximum finite value, preserving the array. Reject empty input with Empty array.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use a single pass with an initial value taken from the sequence rather than zero, which fails for all-negative data.
alternativeApproaches: Compute minimum and maximum together and report their stable first positions.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: All negative; one item; repeated maximum.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
